description: Creates a new task in a project. Use when the user says 'create a task', 'add a task to project X', 'make a new task called Y'. Requires both project_id and name. WARNING: This is a write tool — it creates a real task record. Always confirm project_id and task name before calling. Requires TaskManagement feature. Disabled in demo mode. Requires mcp:write scope for OAuth tokens.

assigned_user_id.description: UUID of the employee to assign this task to. Optional — defaults to unassigned.

description.description: Optional longer description of the task.

due_date.description: Due date in ISO 8601 format. Optional.

estimated_hours.description: Estimated hours to complete the task. Optional.

project_id.description: Project UUID to create the task in. Use list_projects to find project IDs. Required.

name: create_task

project_id.description: Project the task was added to

task_id.description: UUID of the newly created task

title: Create Task
